topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence: If you still feel there is a problem with your fees, report your concern to the SEC, FINRA, or the North American Securities Administrators Association (NASAA).
question: If you still have a concern after asking about fees, what can you do?
answer: You can report your concern to the SEC, FINRA, or the North American Securities Administrators Association (NASAA). The source also suggests asking questions and, in some cases, discussing whether fees can be reduced with your investment professional.
